title: Fast Quadratic Manifold Learning For Nonlinear Dimensionality Reduction in Large-scale Systems using Riemannian Optimization
summary: The effectiveness of dimensionality reduction with quadratic manifolds hinges on the choice of a reduced basis and the associated quadratic correction terms. Existing approaches typically rely on subspaces spanned by the leading principal components of the training data. Although optimal for linear approximation, such bases are inherently suboptimal for quadratic manifold learning.
